== Trivia ==
* Enadiz spelled backwards is Zidane. In an infamous incident, Zinedine Zidane, a famous French soccer player, [[W:Zinedine Zidane#Discipline|head-butted Italian player Marco Materazzi]] in the 2006 World Cup Final. Curiously, the French translation of this boss' name is Enidz, not Enadiz.
